images.prompt: Vertical cinematic film still, photorealistic, warm golden color grade, fine film grain. Keep the lower third darker and calm for text. No text, letters, numbers, posters, logos or watermarks. No people. close-up. A pair of old worn red leather boxing gloves hanging by their laces from a rusty nail on a cracked plaster wall of an old boxing gym, light beams through dust, a patched heavy bag blurred in the background.
